cues: At the university entrance, outdoor racks fill before morning lectures and gradually empty after dusk.
During July’s mountain stage, spectators line the Alpine roads, cheering a colorful procession toward the summit.
When downtown traffic stalls, commuters choose a protected corridor separated from cars by concrete barriers.
After the curtain call, stagehands coil cables and return scenery to numbered storage bays.
At dawn, a baker slides trays of proofed dough into the oven before opening the shop.
During a storm, astronomers postpone rooftop observations until the cloud cover finally clears.
